data_structures: GuardDuty finding record with account, region, severity, resource, and action context
default VPC Flow Log text record with interface, tuple, packet, byte, action, and log status fields

explicit_gaps: Live AWS account export paths and collector envelopes such as EventBridge, Firehose, S3/SQS, CloudWatch, Cribl, and custom relay jobs are not proven by this harness
VPC Flow custom log formats, S3 server-access logs, Cost and Usage Reports, Security Hub wrappers, and service-specific records outside the fixtures remain out of scope
Field validation with retained real tenant/product telemetry requires sanctioned samples or a non-production AWS test feed

timestamp_policy.primary_field: eventTime or updatedAt for JSON records; start/end epoch fields for VPC Flow Logs
timestamp_policy.primary_timezone: UTC for ISO-8601 Z timestamps and epoch seconds
timestamp_policy.notes: CloudTrail and GuardDuty fixtures use UTC ISO-8601 timestamps. VPC Flow Logs use documented epoch start/end fields.

field_delimiting.field_separator: JSON object per line for CloudTrail/GuardDuty; space-delimited VPC Flow Log default format
field_delimiting.escape_policy: JSON escaping for JSON records; space-delimited flow record uses no quoted fields
field_delimiting.notes: VPC Flow Log fixture appends a synthetic marker token after the documented default fields for fixture validation only. CloudTrail sequence fixtures preserve JSON requestParameters/responseElements shape with safe synthetic values.

source.notes: Fixtures use AWS documentation account 123456789012, example names, and RFC5737/documentation IP ranges; no customer or tenant data.

pack_variants.label: CloudTrail JSON relay
pack_variants.description: CloudTrail records preserving eventTime, eventSource, eventName, userIdentity, source IP, and resource/request context.
known_limitations: No live AWS relay replay/read-back captured.
CloudTrail data/impact coverage is represented by synthetic-equivalent S3 GetObject/DeleteObject/PutObject fixtures; not exhaustive S3 or all service data-event coverage.
pack_variants.event_boundary: one JSON object per physical line after collector/object-store/API envelope unwrapping; no array batching is fixture-backed
pack_variants.events_per_file_or_message: one source record per relayed syslog/message line; source export files may contain many records but collector must split before relay
pack_variants.uniqueness_or_multiline: fixture-backed records are unique one-line events; multiline JSON, CloudTrail Records[] file envelopes, and nested collector wrappers require local normalization before SC4S relay
pack_variants.field_delimiting_or_escaping: JSON object syntax with standard quoting/escaping; preserve nested requestParameters, responseElements, userIdentity, service, and resource objects without lossy flattening
pack_variants.timestamp_timezone: CloudTrail eventTime and GuardDuty updatedAt are UTC ISO-8601 values in fixtures; syslog wrapper time is relay metadata only until local read-back verifies precedence

pack_variants.label: GuardDuty finding JSON relay
pack_variants.description: GuardDuty Finding records preserving type, severity, account, region, resource, service/action, and network context.
known_limitations: No live GuardDuty relay replay/read-back captured.
Nested subtype-specific finding fields require local sample comparison.
pack_variants.event_boundary: one GuardDuty finding JSON object per physical line after EventBridge/Security Hub/collector envelope unwrapping; no API page or findings[] wrapper is fixture-backed
pack_variants.events_per_file_or_message: one source record per relayed syslog/message line; source export files may contain many records but collector must split before relay
pack_variants.uniqueness_or_multiline: fixture-backed records are unique one-line events; multiline JSON, CloudTrail Records[] file envelopes, and nested collector wrappers require local normalization before SC4S relay
pack_variants.field_delimiting_or_escaping: JSON object syntax with standard quoting/escaping; preserve nested requestParameters, responseElements, userIdentity, service, and resource objects without lossy flattening
pack_variants.timestamp_timezone: GuardDuty updatedAt is a UTC ISO-8601 value in fixtures; createdAt and service event timestamps may be useful context but are not the primary fixture parse target

pack_variants.label: VPC Flow Log default-format relay
pack_variants.description: Space-delimited VPC Flow Log default field order with explicit logFormat limitation.
known_limitations: Only documented default field order is fixture-backed; custom logFormat deployments must be mapped locally.
pack_variants.event_boundary: one VPC Flow Log default-format text record per physical line after CloudWatch/S3/Firehose/collector splitting
pack_variants.events_per_file_or_message: one flow record per relayed syslog/message line; source log files or batches must be split before relay
pack_variants.uniqueness_or_multiline: fixture-backed flow records are unique one-line records; multiline, aggregated, or custom-delimited exports are not covered
pack_variants.field_delimiting_or_escaping: space-delimited AWS default field order: version account-id interface-id srcaddr dstaddr srcport dstport protocol packets bytes start end action log-status, plus fixture marker only in test data
pack_variants.timestamp_timezone: VPC Flow Log start/end are Unix epoch seconds in UTC; relay/syslog header time must not replace source interval semantics during validation

cribl.notes: Use after sampling the local AWS feed. Do not drop identity, account, source IP, resource, finding, or flow tuple/counter context by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

known_limitations: No live AWS relay, SC4S runtime replay, or Splunk read-back evidence; keep curated/unverified and do not promote to validated/verified.
Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples, not real tenant records.
VPC Flow Log fixture covers default field order only; custom logFormat requires local mapping.
Reduction candidates are opt-in and review-required; no default lossy drops are included.
S3 server access logs and AWS Cost and Usage Reports are not currently separate source families; CloudTrail data events are required for detailed S3 object-level dashboard evidence.
